title: Add UI filters for CPU/GPU and native OS support on the project list
summary: ### Describe the problem Finding the right BOINC project can be tedious and frustrating due to missing filtering options and extra clicks during setup: Limited Project Filtering: The current project list only allows filtering by broad categories (like mathematics or biology). There is no way to filter projects by hardware requirements (CPU-only vs. CPU+GPU) or by native OS support out-of-the-box. Conflated OS Filtering: Filtering currently often gets muddied by Docker support, which makes almost any project technically run anywhere, hiding whether a project actually provides native compiled binaries for specific platforms. ### Describe the solution you'd like Hardware & OS Checkbox Filters: Add checkbox-based filters to the project list view so users can filter projects by: Hardware: CPU-only vs. CPU & GPU supported. Out-of-the-box Native OS: Filtering strictly by native client support (excluding Docker workarounds) so users on lightweight Linux nodes, mobile/Android, or native desktop clients instantly know what's compatible. ### Additional context These small UI polish changes would drastically improve the onboarding and project discovery experience for both new volunteers and experienced grid operators.
